Test case: Compare button and Enter search results
Preconditions: Product list is available and a word matches multiple products
Steps: Search using the button; record product identities; reset; search the same word using Enter; compare identities
Test data: A word shared by multiple products and not all the products
Expected result: Both methods return the same matching products with no extras or missing products

Test case: Replace a previous search with a different word
Preconditions: Product list is available and two words have distinguishable matches
Steps: Search for the first word; replace it with the second word; press Enter
Test data: Two words with different matching products
Expected result: Results reflect the second word rather than stale first-search results

Test case: Show no results for an unmatched search
Steps: Search for a word known not to match any product
Expected result: Page indicates no matches and shows zero product cards

Preconditions: Record the full unfiltered product list before searching
Steps: Search for a matching word; click the clear button; inspect the search box and product list
Test data: A word matching a subset of products
Expected result: Searching matching word shows subset of products; Search box is empty and the full unfiltered product list returns after the step of clearing search

Preconditions: Record the full unfiltered product list before searching
Steps: Search for a nonexistent word; click the clear button
Expected result: Searing unmatched word results in empty page i.e no products; Search box is empty and the full unfiltered product list returns with no stale no-results state once clear search button is pressed

Test case: Sort all products by descending price
Preconditions: Product list contains products with different prices
Steps: Select price high to low; inspect all products in the sorted list
Expected result: Every adjacent price is non-increasing and the most expensive product is first

Test case: Sort all products by descending name
Preconditions: Product list contains products with different names
Steps: Select name Z to A; inspect all products in the sorted list
Expected result: Product names are in descending alphabetical order

Test case: Sort Power Tools by descending price
Preconditions: Power Tools category contains products with different prices
Steps: Open Power Tools; select price high to low; inspect category label and products
Expected result: Category label remains Power Tools; only power tools are shown; prices are non-increasing

Test case: Type a quantity before adding a product
Preconditions: An in-stock product is available and cart is empty
Steps: Open the product; replace the quantity by typing; add to cart; open cart
Expected result: Cart shows the selected product with quantity 3

Test case: Update cart quantity and all dependent amounts
Preconditions: Cart contains one in-stock non-eco product with known unit price
Steps: Change its quantity in the cart; inspect the line price; total and cart icon count
Expected result: Line price equals unit price times 3; cart total equals the non-eco line price; cart icon count is 3

Test case: Update one of multiple cart lines
Preconditions: Cart contains two different in-stock non-eco products with known unit prices
Steps: Change the quantity of one item; inspect both lines; cart total and cart icon count
Expected result: Changed line equals unit price times 2; other line is unchanged; total equals both lines; icon count is 3

Test case: Verify eco line price despite discount
Preconditions: Cart contains an eco product with known unit price and an applicable eco discount
Steps: Set a positive quantity; inspect unit price; line price and cart total
Expected result: Line price equals unit price times quantity; discounted total is lower than line sum and is not reported as a defect

Test case: Remove the last item from the cart
Steps: Remove the product; inspect the cart
Expected result: Product is absent and cart indicates it is empty

Test case: Remove one item from a multi-item cart
Preconditions: Cart contains two different non-eco products
Steps: Remove one product; inspect the remaining cart
Expected result: Removed item is absent; the other remains with correct quantity and price

Preconditions: Contact form is available; no completed form will be submitted
Steps: For each of the five fields in turn leave that field empty and fill the other four; press Send; inspect validation
Test data: Valid first name; last name; email; subject; message
Expected result: Each omitted field is identified as required and the form is not sent

Test case: Show one validation message under each empty field
Steps: Press Send on the empty form; inspect all five fields
Expected result: Each empty field has its own validation message beneath it and the form is not sent

Test case: Retain entered and selected contact values
Steps: Enter first name; last name; email; choose a subject and enter a message; move focus between fields; inspect values; do not press Send
Test data: Example names; test@example.com; an available subject; sample message
Expected result: All five entered or selected values remain unchanged

Test case: Retain filled fields after incomplete-form validation
Preconditions: Contact form is available; at least one field remains empty
Steps: Fill first name; email and message; leave last name and subject empty; press Send; inspect retained values
Test data: Example first name; test@example.com; sample message
Expected result: Entered values remain unchanged and missing fields are identified; the form is not sent

Preconditions: An out-of-stock product is available and its identity is known
Steps: Open the product; attempt to add it if an add control is available; inspect cart contents
Expected result: Product cannot be added to cart; no specific stock message is required
